title: Service Comparison Sheet: What Each Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services Report Contains
content:
# Service Comparison Sheet: Examination and Report Contents

Service by service under Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services, whether a signed written report is issued, the purposes a value may be stated for, the approach by which value is arrived at and the examinations the report includes are as follows.

| Service | Signed written report | Purposes a value is stated for | Approach to value | Photographs in the report | Stones tested | Principal stone plotted | Metal assayed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Verbal Counter Estimate | No | Identification only | Laboratory grading | No | No | No | No |
| Insurance Replacement Appraisal | Yes | Insurance replacement | Replacement cost new | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Fair Market Value Appraisal | Yes | Fair market; resale liquidation | Comparable sales | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Estate and Probate Appraisal | Yes | Estate probate; fair market | Liquidation | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Certified Gemological Laboratory Report | Yes | Identification only; insurance replacement | Laboratory grading | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Collection Portfolio Appraisal | Yes | Insurance replacement; fair market; estate probate | Replacement cost new | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## What the columns mean

- **Signed written report**: whether a signed written report is issued rather than a spoken opinion.
- **Purposes**: the purposes this service will state a value for; a service offers only the purposes listed against it.
- **Approach to value**: how value is arrived at under this service, one of replacement cost new, comparable sales, liquidation or laboratory grading.
- **Photographs**: whether the report carries photographs of the piece.
- **Stones tested**: whether the stones are tested rather than accepted as described.
- **Principal stone plotted**: whether the report plots the inclusions of the principal stone.
- **Metal assayed**: whether the metal is assayed rather than taken from the hallmark.

## Purposes by service, read the other way

| Purpose | Services that state a value for it |
|---|---|
| Identification only | Verbal Counter Estimate; Certified Gemological Laboratory Report |
| Insurance replacement | Insurance Replacement Appraisal; Certified Gemological Laboratory Report; Collection Portfolio Appraisal |
| Fair market | Fair Market Value Appraisal; Estate and Probate Appraisal; Collection Portfolio Appraisal |
| Resale liquidation | Fair Market Value Appraisal |
| Estate probate | Estate and Probate Appraisal; Collection Portfolio Appraisal |

The Verbal Counter Estimate is the only service that issues no signed written report, and the Estate and Probate Appraisal, the Certified Gemological Laboratory Report and the Collection Portfolio Appraisal are the three whose reports include every examination on the sheet.
